SELECT 'country' AS node_type, country_number AS number, country_name AS name, country_number AS country_number, NULL AS parent_number, NULL AS division_level FROM sys_md_base_country WHERE deleted = 0
AND country_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.countryNumber}, '%')
AND country_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.countryName}, '%')
ORDER BY country_number

SELECT 'division' AS node_type, division_number AS number, division_name AS name, country_number AS country_number, parent_number AS parent_number, division_level AS division_level FROM sys_md_base_admin_division WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY country_number, division_number
SELECT division_number FROM sys_md_base_admin_division WHERE deleted = 0 AND parent_number = #{parentNumber}

SELECT a.id AS id, a.create_by AS create_by, a.create_time AS create_time, a.update_by AS update_by, a.update_time AS update_time, a.deleted AS deleted,
c.country_name AS country_name, a.country_number AS country_number,
a.division_number AS division_number, a.division_name AS division_name, a.parent_number AS parent_number, p.division_name AS parent_name, a.division_level AS division_level,
a.full_spell AS full_spell, a.simple_spell AS simple_spell, a.description AS description, a.city_number AS city_number, a.time_zone AS time_zone, a.city_flag AS city_flag, a.area_code AS area_code, a.enable_flag AS enable_flag FROM sys_md_base_admin_division a LEFT JOIN sys_md_base_country c ON a.country_number = c.country_number AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_md_base_admin_division p ON a.parent_number = p.division_number AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.country_number = #{vo.treeCountryNumber}
AND a.division_number IN
#{item}
AND a.country_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.countryNumber}, '%')
AND c.country_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.countryName}, '%')
AND a.division_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.divisionNumber}, '%')
AND a.division_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.divisionName}, '%')
AND a.parent_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.parentNumber}, '%')
AND p.division_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.parentName}, '%')
AND a.division_level = #{vo.divisionLevel}
AND a.full_spell LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.fullSpell}, '%')
AND a.simple_spell LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.simpleSpell}, '%')
AND a.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.description}, '%')
AND a.city_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.cityNumber}, '%')
AND a.time_zone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.timeZone}, '%')
AND a.city_flag = #{vo.cityFlag}
AND a.area_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.areaCode}, '%')
AND a.enable_flag = #{vo.enableFlag}
ORDER BY a.country_number, a.division_number
